notablePrerequisites: You control up to two mana-producing lands that can tap to produce at least {2}.
description:
Activate Primal Wellspring and two other mana-producing lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}, ensuring to use the mana produced by Primal Wellspring.
Primal Wellspring triggers, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice, untap Primal Wellspring and untap the two other lands.
Holding priority, activate Primal Wellspring and two other mana-producing lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, targeting Frantic Search, ensuring to use the mana produced by Primal Wellspring.
Primal Wellspring triggers, copying Reiterate targeting Frantic Search.
Resolve both Reiterates, copying Frantic Search twice and returning the original Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the first copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice, untap Primal Wellspring and untap the two other lands.
 Activate Primal Wellspring and two other mana-producing lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Resolve the second copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice, untap Primal Wellspring and untap the two other lands.
Repeat from step 5.
